identity.historical_identity_caveat: Bugler names Healy as the starting mechanism, but the current nc5_49 and July-2015 files are not authenticated publication-era snapshots.
attempts: Inspected both mechanism headers and filenames for a publication date or immutable release identifier.
Read Bugler 2015 section 2, which names Healy's model as the starting mechanism but does not fingerprint nc5_49 bytes.
Compared the retrieved endpoint species and reaction-entry counts with the census evidence.
evidence: Bugler et al. 2015 section 2 states that the model is based on the n-pentane mechanism developed by Healy et al.
The nc5_49 filename and 293/1593 inventory are consistent with the retrieved historical release.
No primary source located ties either frozen SHA-256 to the exact submitted/published mechanism bytes.

scoring.recovered: A structurally accepted type earns one unit once; duplicate entries, fitted rates, and extra members earn no additional credit.
scoring.baseline_present: Classify the generated baseline first; a type already present receives baseline coverage and zero revision credit.
scoring.secondary_metric: For each measured species, mean absolute log10(max(x_sim,L_s)/max(x_exp,L_s)) over its frozen rows; the overall score is the unweighted mean of species scores.
scoring.species_aggregation: Rows are equally weighted within species and species are equally weighted; report every per-species score and scored-row count.
scoring.zero_and_detection_limit_policy: L_s is the stated detection limit where supplied; otherwise half the smallest strictly positive frozen observation for that species. Exact zeros and values below L_s are clamped to L_s. A species with no positive value and no stated limit is refused, never assigned zero error.
refusals: missing or nonfinite simulated mole fraction
negative simulated or experimental mole fraction
species with no stated detection limit and no positive frozen observation
unsupported reactor condition or solver failure
scoring.locking: Lock candidate, baseline, contract hash, structural matcher, JSR adapter and simulator before one holdout evaluation; no holdout-driven retries, tuning or exclusions.

leakage_limits: The Bugler ignition-delay study validated v_new and is development data, never holdout.
The JSR holdout shares mechanism-community authors with the revision; historical blindness is not claimed.
Keep v_new bytes, mapped reactions and labels out of the revision agent and retrieval tools until candidate locking.
Thermochemistry and rate-rule changes made with the revision are excluded from structural ground truth.
Korcek chemistry was not included in v_new and is not a scored type.
ChemKED n-pentane records are NOx-doped and excluded from both sets.
Hash drift, split-count drift and unresolved eligible old structures fail the benchmark rather than shrinking it.
